# Test cases for test_config.yaml
# Format: HOST PATH [QUERY]

# Test home rule (exact match)
test.example.com /

# Test api rule (prefix match with query)
test.example.com /api
test.example.com /api/v1/users
test.example.com /api/v1/users id=123

# Test static rule (prefix match, no query)
test.example.com /static
test.example.com /static/js/app.js
test.example.com /static/css/style.css version=1.0
